title: Select the hosted generator in an authored Razor build task
goal: Choose the engine or hosted source-generator path in a custom Razor MSBuild target, supply its discovery dependencies, and verify the generated code and diagnostics with matching SDK tools.

selectionNotes: Advanced authored task target; exact toolset qualification, not normal application build configuration.
Retains the working .NET 10 engine/default comparison; no hosted older-target backport.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Run matching MSBuild/rzc and the generated component consumer on the current runtime family.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Advanced task authoring uses this SDK task/rzc/compiler/MSBuild closure. Requalify any replacement toolset.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical current consumer language; the task selection itself requires no C#15 syntax.

frameworks: Microsoft.NETCore.App 11 and Microsoft.AspNetCore.App 11; Microsoft.NET.Sdk with authored generation target.
packageAssets: SDK tasks/net11.0/Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Razor.Tasks.dll and its adjacent dependencies; matching tools/rzc.dll, runtimeconfig/deps, compiler/utility/CSS parser; SDK MSBuild and Roslyn. Project-owned ExhibitParts dependency, no compiler NuGet package.
platforms: Managed dotnet MSBuild host; measured Windows x64. No native assets or optional workloads.
renderingModes: Generated component executed by in-process HtmlRenderer, without browser or interactive rendering.
prerequisites: Author and own the custom MSBuild target; install the exact SDK/runtime/reference packs. Build discovery dependencies before task invocation; pass absolute reference assembly paths.
constraints: Explicit UseSourceGenerator=true on both public tasks; Assemblies on discovery and generation. SDK10 lacks the new flag and generate Assemblies parameter.
The underscored _RazorToolUseSourceGenerator forwarding property is internal SDK implementation detail, not a stable application setting.
Use matching task/rzc/compiler/MSBuild/runtime artifacts. No mixed-SDK or older-target hosted route is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 execution only; not GA-qualified. Public task parameters exist but this custom tooling integration is version coupled; no stable SDK-layout/ABI promise or experimental suppression.
